Chapter 864: Chapter 9: Sweeping (Please Subscribe)

“The Galaxy Master is waiting for us?”

The enormous rock life entity carefully observed Lin Yuan.

Had it been any other eleven-rank being, daring to stand in the way at the entrance of the Space-Time Path, it would have long since struck to kill.

But the Galaxy Master?

The rock life entity was not frightened of the Galaxy Master.

It was just a newcomer to the eleventh rank.

What the rock life entity truly feared…

was the civilization behind the Galaxy Master—Human Civilization.

And those nine supreme beings high above all others.

Given the Galaxy Master’s status within human civilization, since he dares to enter this extra-large battlefield, even if it’s just an avatar descending.

He must possess the trump cards and backup plans bestowed by the nine supreme beings of human civilization.

“Almost there.”

Lin Yuan glanced at the Spatial-Temporal Maze.

More and more eleven-rank beings were now making it past the Spatial-Temporal Maze, stopping to look at him.

The maze’s obstructive effect was substantial for those eleven-rank beings who first entered.

As for the eleven-rank beings entering the maze later? Those who came before had already damaged the maze greatly, and the successors could quickly make it through, approaching the Space-Time Path.

This action was also to lower the chance of the faster eleven-rank beings arriving at the Space-Time Path first, thus entering the core area of the battlefield without any skirmish.

The purpose of opening up such a large battlefield is to let the strong from all species fight and settle the score.

Of course, as for someone like Lin Yuan who forcefully travels through space and time, arriving at the Space-Time Path half a day early is completely beyond what the Spatial-Temporal Maze can prevent.

A dozen breaths later.

All the eleven-rank beings in this region had gathered in front of the Space-Time Path, focusing intently on Lin Yuan, who sat cross-legged.

“The Galaxy Master…”

Among the many eleven-rank beings, several from the Human Civilization Alliance felt their scalps tingle.

They felt the Galaxy Master’s behavior was far too arrogant.

Originally, as the greatest prodigy in the history of human civilization, the Galaxy Master would undoubtedly be targeted in this extra-large battlefield.

Logically, the Galaxy Master should keep as low a profile as possible.

But now? Blocking the path in public, isn’t this giving foreign eleven-rank beings the opportunity to join forces against him?

“Galaxy Master, what exactly…”

Yu Race Mingche’s expression changed uncertainly, just about to speak.

Just then.

Lin Yuan, who had been sitting at the entrance of the Space-Time Path, began to gather a faint Xuan Huang colored glow around his body.

A heavy, oppressive aura began to spread, enveloping all the foreign eleven-rank beings in an instant.

The only reason Lin Yuan waited until now to make a move was simply out of laziness to chase and kill.

Rather than searching every nook and cranny of this peripheral region over and over, it was better to wait here at the entrance of the Space-Time Path like lying in wait for a hare.

Any of those eleven-rank foreign beings with the thought of entering the core area of the battlefield would necessarily come here.

“Galaxy Master, you’re courting death.”

The enormous rock life entity roared with rage; it was wary of the Human Civilization behind the Galaxy Master but not intimidated.

Even facing Yu Race Mingche, who held an ultimate weapon, the enormous rock life entity dared to clash a few times. The Galaxy Master? Even if he truly possessed a trump card bestowed by a supreme being, how much of it could be utilized?

With his own strength, lacking the enlightenment of the Fifth Realm, he cannot even achieve preliminary refinement of an ultimate weapon.

Boom!

The enormous rock life entity immediately took a step forward, extending its right hand which began to grow insanely large, reaching hundreds of thousands of feet in a blink, and slammed it towards Lin Yuan.

The next moment.

The right arm that the enormous rock life entity reached out abruptly turned into nothingness, followed by its own solid rock body, which began to crumble and disintegrate.

“What?”

The other eleven-rank foreign beings around had their expressions change drastically; the strength of the enormous rock life entity was nearly on par with Yu Race Mingche.

If not for slightly lesser comprehension of space-time, it would definitely have been bestowed with an ultimate weapon.

But now? To disintegrate directly in front of the Galaxy Master?

“Join forces.”

“Together.”

“Otherwise, we all die.”

Including Yu Race Mingche, all the foreign eleven-rank beings had this thought simultaneously in their hearts.

In a flash, they had no time to contemplate the multitude of questions like why the Galaxy Master has such formidable strength.

Rumbling… A terrifying aura boiled among the numerous foreign eleven-rank beings; Yu Race Mingche suddenly produced a black axe in his hand, emitting a deep luster and a breath that surpassed the eleventh rank.

Although Yu Race Mingche had initially refined an ultimate weapon, he wouldn’t use it unless absolutely necessary.

There’s no helping it; activating an ultimate weapon’s power is extremely draining, so much so that Yu Race Mingche, even burning his flesh and soul, couldn’t sustain many strikes.

That was also the reason why the enormous rock life entity and other special beings from the Star Alliance were able to hold him back in the Spatial-Temporal Maze just now.

Of course, even without actively utilizing an ultimate weapon, simply ‘passively’ employing its power also allowed Yu Race Mingche’s strength to climb significantly.

“Not bad, truly the elite from the peak powers of various species.”

Lin Yuan’s gaze was calm, his mind idly contemplating.

With his strength, if he went all out, these foreign eleven-rank beings wouldn’t stand a chance at all.

But doing so, revealing too much strength, risks frightening the true powerhouses of the various peak species forces in the core area of the battlefield.

As a result, those true powerhouses, avoiding Lin Yuan in the core area of the battlefield, might even choose to withdraw from this extra-large battlefield’s contention.

“Fine, I’ll play along with you.”

Lin Yuan’s thoughts stirred slightly, and the Xuanhuang Force Field engulfing all directions began to slowly contract.
